Three.js 0.186.1, MIT, https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js

Vendored from the official npm three package. Only three.module.js, three.core.js,
FBXLoader, NURBSCurve, NURBSUtils and fflate are included. Imports of 'three' in
the example modules are changed to the local relative ../three.module.js path.
No game or mod geometry or textures are included. See LICENSE and fflate header.
